## Appointment reminders by SMS with quiet hours
Sends a booking confirmation and two reminders by text for each appointment, and never texts a customer during quiet hours. Every send time is worked out the moment the booking arrives, so the rest of the workflow just waits.

### How it works
1. Your booking tool, form or CRM POSTs the appointment to the webhook: customer_name, phone, appointment_time (ISO, like 2026-09-24T14:00) and service.
2. A Code node checks the phone and the time, then plans three texts: a confirmation now, a reminder 24 hours before and one 2 hours before.
3. Quiet hours are applied up front. A reminder that would land in quiet hours moves earlier, to 30 minutes before they start, so it still arrives before the appointment. The confirmation moves later, to when quiet hours end.
4. Reminders that would already be in the past, or would land right on top of another text, are skipped.
5. If the phone or the time is unusable, you get a text instead and nothing goes to the customer.

### Setup steps
1. Add a Twilio credential (Account SID and Auth Token) and select it on the four Twilio nodes.
2. Open **Your settings** and fill in your business name, your Twilio number and your cell in +1XXXXXXXXXX format, your time zone, the reminder hours and quiet hours.
3. Set the workflow time zone in workflow settings to match.
4. Activate, then POST a test booking to the production webhook URL. The response shows when each text is planned.

## 1. Booking in, texts planned
The webhook answers right away with the planned send times, or the reason nothing was planned. Times with no offset are read in your time zone.

## 2. Confirmation
Goes out now, or when quiet hours end if the booking arrives at night.

## 3. Two reminders
Each Wait resumes at its planned time. A skipped reminder passes straight through. If an appointment moves or is cancelled, stop its waiting run in Executions and send the booking again.

## Details unusable
You get a text saying why, and the customer gets nothing.
